meta.policy: Flagged items do not block publication; they are review work.

items.detail: After reading all 37 Venetian DSE IV structure sheets in full (2026-11-17), none states a re-entry, rebuy, add-on, freezeout or single-entry policy. Silence is not confirmation: NO Venetian event can be labeled 'single-entry confirmed'. The 'Single-entry / freezeout confirmed' toggle therefore shows 0 matching rows until the poker room confirms in writing.

The official Bellagio Saturday PDF is internally inconsistent: filename says $1000, header says '$1100 BUY-IN', rule 07 allocates 'the $600 Buy-in' ($510/$50/$40). It also describes flights (1A–1D) with a combined Day 2 '9/13/26'. Buy-in left blank; verify with the Bellagio poker room before planning.

The official WPT schedule PDF prints two rows as 'Dec. 18 Wednesday' and one as 'Dec. 18 Friday'; in 2026 Dec 18 is a Friday and Dec 16 is the Wednesday. The Wednesday rows may belong to Dec 16. Dates left as printed and flagged; verify with the Wynn poker room.

The earliest verified start anywhere in the official schedules read is 9:10 AM (Venetian satellite #46) and 10:10 AM for open tournaments (Seniors/RaceDay). A strict 8 AM–onward tournament day is not achievable in this snapshot; the day plan starts at 9:10/10:10 AM and says so.

Official sites publish no scraped date-specific totals (checkout total / nightly average) outside their booking engines. The rate log keeps dated, timestamped published rates and fees; the Hotels page links the official booking engine per date and provides a true-cost calculator. Occupancy + exact dates are required before any like-for-like comparison.
Bellagio's official fee page returned 404 and Caesars Palace's fee page carries no amount (both checked 2026-11-16). Third-party figures conflict and are not used. Fee fields left blank and flagged.

items.topic: Venetian schedule labels vs structure sheets
items.detail: The official schedule page marks some events '$20 rake disc' / '$40 rake disc' (e.g. #16/#36/#59/#56); the discount wording actually appears on structure sheets 4, 8, 35, 36 only. Sheet 11/16 contain no discount clause. Discounts verified only where the sheet states them.

No official source publishes event end times. Overlap flags use start time + late-registration cutoff + a documented plausible-duration heuristic (see Schedule page). Once real finish times are observed, replace the heuristic and re-check overlaps.

Venetian multi-flight events (sheets 2/3/4/9/10/12/13/14/20/21/35/36/37) only state 'Any player who bags chips for Day 2 may not play a subsequent flight' — implying repeat buy-ins via new flights are possible unless bagged. Within-flight re-entry remains unverified. WPT events explicitly allow unlimited re-entry per flight (confirmed).

Structure sheet 8 rule 07 says 'All subsequent buy in's after the initial buy in will be $200', implying multiple buy-ins are possible, but no re-entry policy clause exists. Not single-entry-confirmed.
